panels.title: Internet
panels.description: Up if any internet-tier probe (ICMP, DNS or HTTPS beyond Ting) succeeded on the last scrape.

panels.title: Latest speedtest vs 1 Gbps plan
panels.description: Green at 80% of plan or better, yellow from 50%, red below. TCP overhead caps a 1 Gbps line at about 940 Mbps, so ~94% is effectively full speed.

panels.title: Path to the internet
panels.description: Share of probes that succeeded over the selected time range, from the Pi's point of view. Read left to right: the first node that isn't green is where the path breaks. Zoom into an outage to see where it happened. The switch and ONT don't answer probes, so the lines through them take the colour of the next measured hop. Green ≥ 99.9%, yellow ≥ 99%.

panels.title: Reachability by tier
panels.description: lan = home router; isp = Ting's first hops; internet = services beyond Ting. The lowest tier that goes red is where the problem is.

panels.title: Probe failures by target
panels.description: Spikes here without a matching tier outage are individual targets flaking, not your connection.

panels.title: Download
panels.description: Median of all tests in each bucket (at least a day), with the middle 50% (p25–p75) and middle 80% (p10–p90) shaded. Data before Nov 2026 comes from the legacy collector, which picked a random server per test, so its bands are wider.
